AI streamed calls: your own handoff targets, the media credential, and results that always arrive.

Untapped handoff targets: when an Untapped agent hands a caller to a person it names where, such as billing or support. Under AI providers, Untapped AI, Handoff targets, you now point each name at a queue, a team, an agent or an outside number, and change it whenever you like with nothing to change at Untapped. A team's calls are offered to that team's agents only. A name not on the list is refused straight away and the caller stays with the AI, so add your names before going live.

Untapped results: a streamed call's transcript shows who said what (Caller and Agent), its outcome (resolved, abandoned and so on) is recorded, and a call whose result never arrived is picked up within the hour, including calls that failed before they started. When Untapped is briefly at capacity the call waits a moment and tries once more before taking its fallback, and a capacity refusal no longer trips the safety switch that stops sending calls to Untapped.

Untapped media credential: streaming now uses Untapped's media credential (it starts umi_), entered on the Untapped provider's Edit form under New media credential for streaming; streamed calls start and are read with it, and the service token stays for agents, routes and phone setup. Call details sent to Untapped are limited to what its route accepts (at first the customer's name and account reference); anything else is left out and noted on the call's timeline, so a call is never refused for its details."}
